unified_features.name: Ticket statuses
unified_features.rationale: Only Helpdesk has tickets; nothing to merge.
unified_features.behaviour: Every ticket has status open, pending or closed (database check constraint). A new customer ticket or customer message sets pending; an agent reply sets open; closing sets closed.
unified_features.improvements: Status transitions are made explicit; A never sets open or pending.

unified_features.name: Agent replies
unified_features.behaviour: An agent posts a reply on a ticket; it is stored as a Message with the agent's user id and appears in the thread; a pending ticket becomes open.
unified_features.improvements: Empty body rejected (A accepted it); sender recorded as a user id rather than the fixed label 'agent'.

unified_features.name: Close ticket
unified_features.behaviour: An agent closes an open ticket; closing a pending ticket is refused with error code ticket_pending ('answer the customer first').

unified_features.name: FAQ entries
unified_features.behaviour: Admins add, edit and delete FAQ entries (question, answer); B's existing entry is seeded.
unified_features.improvements: Stored and editable instead of hard-coded.

unified_features.name: Suggested FAQ answers on tickets
unified_features.rationale: Faqbot's matcher applied to Helpdesk tickets: the combination the user asked for.
unified_features.behaviour: When an agent opens a ticket, up to 3 FAQ entries are suggested, ranked by shared meaningful words between the ticket's subject and customer messages and each FAQ question; the agent can insert a suggested answer into a reply draft.
unified_features.improvements: Punctuation stripped, stop words ignored, results ranked and capped at 3 (B matched on any shared word, including 'how' and 'i').
